icons.label: 书库
icons.subject: Three upright hardcover books on a short shelf, one leaning, one ribbon bookmark.

icons.label: 文件传输
icons.subject: Two large interlocking horizontal arrows pointing opposite directions, one dark teal and one light warm ochre, with a single cream document sheet tucked behind. Clear file exchange.

icons.label: 网络书库
icons.subject: An open cream book in front of a dark teal globe with just one longitude and latitude arc. Book dominates, globe clearly visible above it. Online catalog, not a bookshelf.

icons.label: 微信读书
icons.subject: A friendly open book with two tiny rounded chat speech bubbles above it, one dark teal and one warm ochre. Social reading. Invent an original symbol; no copied brand logo or wordmark.

icons.label: AirPage
icons.subject: A framed picture showing one dark mountain and a warm ochre sun, with a small paper airplane arriving from the upper right. Wireless image delivery. Large clear photo frame and airplane silhouette.

icons.label: 阅读统计
icons.subject: Three large ascending rounded bars growing out of the page of an open cream book. Dark teal, warm ochre and cream bars with dark borders. Reading progress and statistics.

icons.label: 数独
icons.subject: A straight-on rounded square sudoku board simplified to a clean 3 by 3 grid. Exactly nine equal large cells, five blank and four with single large readable digits 1, 2, 3, 9. Cream paper, dark teal border, one ochre highlighted cell.

icons.label: 五子棋
icons.subject: A compact cream wood board with a simple sparse dark lattice and five round Go stones, three nearly black dark teal and two cream white with dark outlines. Diagonal sequence suggests five-in-a-row; not western chess.

icons.label: 推箱子
icons.subject: One warm ochre wooden crate with a bold X brace and one broad dark teal right-pointing push arrow beside it. A single cream target square underneath. Very simple box pushing puzzle.

icons.label: 中国象棋
icons.subject: One large round ivory Chinese chess disc with a dark red carved Chinese character 帅 centered clearly, another dark teal disc partially behind, on a minimal 2-line board corner. Round Chinese xiangqi pieces; no western chess knight, king, pawn.

icons.label: 扫雷
icons.subject: A stylized rounded dark teal minesweeper mine with six short blunt spikes, beside a warm ochre triangular flag on a short pole anchored to one cream square tile. Friendly classic puzzle symbol, no explosion.

Two chunky rounded square puzzle tiles, a smaller light cream tile with a large dark 2 and a larger warm ochre tile with a large dark 4. Offset overlapping diagonal composition implies merging. Only text is exact single digits 2 and 4.

icons.label: 丑丑头像
icons.subject: A quirky friendly human avatar bust with a crooked smile, mismatched round eyes, a tuft of dark teal hair, cream face and ochre shirt. Clearly an amusing generated profile portrait. No enclosing frame.

icons.label: Buddy
icons.subject: A small friendly round duck companion with an ochre body, cream belly, dark teal small wizard hat and big readable dot eyes. Two simple feet, one wing raised. A collectible buddy pet with bold silhouette, not a human avatar.

icons.label: 像素大战
icons.subject: A compact square pixel canvas made from a few large cream, teal and ochre square cells, with one large dark teal pencil touching a single ochre square at lower right. Collaborative pixel painting, no guns or game controller.

icons.label: 计算器
icons.subject: A sturdy straight-on rounded pocket calculator, dark teal body, a large blank cream display and six large buttons; four cream small buttons and two ochre buttons. One large plus and one equal sign only. No tiny digits.

icons.label: 电子木鱼
icons.subject: A warm ochre traditional Chinese wooden fish temple percussion block, rounded hollow carved body with one curved slit, and one dark teal handled wooden mallet hovering diagonally above. Recognizable mokugyo, not a living fish, no fins or tail.

icons.label: 待机显示
icons.subject: A compact cream e-paper display frame showing a simple analog clock with two dark hands; a large warm ochre crescent moon overlaps its upper right corner. Dark teal frame. Quiet standby clock, not a phone.
